- Add an operator permission check to `/dusksthings ghost set`
- Fix Loadouts not working on dedicated servers
- Fix ghost modifications not syncing from commands

Version 2.0.0 of Dusk's Things! Note that nothing from Version 1.0.0 will pass forward to this version, hence the direct jump to 2.0.0.

The mod's code has been restructured to make it easier to work with again, so here's the changelog!

- Added the ability to become a Permanent Ghost using commands to the Ghosts Feature.
   - Spectral Apples still only mark you as a Temporary Ghost, however.
- Reworked the Dusk's Things command! It is now `/dusksthings`, and the `ghosts` subcommand has been redone.
- Loadouts feature
   - Allows you to quickly swap armour sets from your inventory or by pressing certain keybinds (defaults to `ALT + 1 / 2 / 3`)
   - Has toggleable Curios support! On by default, this makes the Loadouts feature also separate your Curios items into different loadouts. This does nothing if you don't have Curios installed.

releases.notes:
Time for a new version! This one's got quite a bit of stuff in it:

- Configuration! In terms of existing features, you can:
  - Modify ghost transparency
  - Toggle whether the Spectral Lens makes invisible entities transparent
  - Toggle whether the Spectral Lens works at all or not
  - Completely disable the Ghost Entities feature (more-so for the future of the mod when I add more)
- Spectral Apples! These allow you to actually become a ghost, and can be obtained by throwing an Apple into Soul Fire.
- The Spectral Transformation status effect, used by the Spectral Apple. Upon expiring, the mob with the effect becomes a ghost. But watch out, if you get injured while transforming, you'll lose the effect and won't become a ghost!

releases.notes:
The first release of Dusk's Things!

Adds the ghost players feature, allowing players and entities alike to be marked as a ghost, making them invisible unless they're in your peripheral vision!

To use the ghost players feature, there are some commands:
`/duskthings ghost add <uuid>` - Makes someone a ghost. **(Requires `/op`)**
`/duskthings ghost remove <uuid>` - Makes someone no longer a ghost. **(Requires `/op`)**
`/duskthings ghost get <uuid>` - Check if someone is a ghost.

Marking someone as a ghost is the only part of the ghost players feature that isn't actually possible completely in survival. You can craft the Spectral Lens in survival, however, allowing you to see both ghost players and invisible entities.
